items.question: What's your turnaround time?
items.answer: Usually 5–7 business days after I receive your product. Rush delivery is available.

items.question: Do you post the content on your own accounts?
items.answer: UGC is made for your brand to post. If you'd like it on my accounts too, I offer that as an add-on.

items.question: Can I run ads with your content?
items.answer: Yes. Paid usage rights can be added for 30, 60 or 90 days, or longer.

items.question: How many revisions are included?
items.answer: One round of revisions is included with every video.

items.question: Where are you based?
items.answer: I'm travelling full time with my boyfriend at the moment and will be settling in Cape Town in 2027. Products can be shipped to wherever I am that month. Just ask and I'll send the current address.

items.question: What currency do you charge in?
items.answer: All prices are in British pounds (£). I can invoice in another currency on request.

items.question: Can you shoot at a hotel or destination?
items.answer: Yes, and I'd love to. Because I'm already on the road, travel and hotel collaborations are easy to fit into my route.
